title: Step 1 change-to-live loop: one deliver command, timed per phase, under 60 s on the dev channel

criteria: local-channel deliver takes a committed change through owning-package unit tests, dev build, governed first-goal check, fast-forward of the dev live lineage ref, promotion and observation of the promoted executable
deliver refuses an unclean tree, a HEAD that does not contain the live lineage, and global inputs that need the full gate, and promotes nothing on a failed test, build or check
every delivery records per-phase wall clock, startup, first output and completion of the governed goal, and optional rollback proof as evidence JSON beside channel.json
measured repetitions for a root-package change and a deepest-crate change are recorded in docs/step1-acceptance.md, with what the loop does not cover
